q1.question: What is LePaysExpressColis?
q1.answer: LePaysExpressColis is a community-driven platform that connects people who need to send packages between Russia and Africa with travelers making the same journey.

q2.question: How does it work?
q2.answer: Travelers publish their upcoming trips with available luggage capacity. Senders search for travelers going to their destination and request delivery. Payment is held in escrow until delivery is confirmed.

q3.question: Is it legal?
q3.answer: Yes, as long as the items being transported are legal and comply with customs regulations in both countries. Users are responsible for ensuring their packages meet all legal requirements.

q1.question: How much does it cost?
q1.answer: Prices vary by route and traveler, but typically range from $5-15 per kg. This is up to 70% cheaper than traditional shipping services.

q2.question: What can I send?
q2.answer: You can send most personal items including gifts, documents, electronics, and clothing. Prohibited items include weapons, drugs, hazardous materials, and anything illegal in either country.

q3.question: How long does delivery take?
q3.answer: Delivery time depends on the traveler's schedule. Most deliveries are completed within 1-7 days of the traveler's arrival.

q1.question: How much can I earn?
q1.answer: Earnings depend on your route and capacity. Travelers typically earn $50-200 per trip by utilizing their unused luggage space.

q2.question: What are my responsibilities?
q2.answer: You must transport the package safely, clear customs if required, and deliver to the agreed location. You should also communicate with the sender throughout the journey.

q3.question: What if I can't complete the delivery?
q3.answer: Contact the sender and our support team immediately. If delivery cannot be completed, the payment will be refunded to the sender.

q1.question: How does escrow payment work?
q1.answer: When a sender pays, the money is held securely by our platform. It's only released to the traveler after the sender confirms successful delivery.

q2.question: What payment methods are accepted?
q2.answer: We accept credit cards, debit cards, and bank transfers. All payments are processed securely through our payment partners.

q3.question: What if there's a dispute?
q3.answer: Our support team will mediate disputes between senders and travelers. We review evidence from both parties and make a fair decision.

q1.question: How do you verify users?
q1.answer: All users must complete KYC verification by uploading a government-issued ID. We verify the authenticity of documents before approving accounts.

q2.question: What if my package is damaged?
q2.answer: We recommend purchasing insurance for valuable items. In case of damage, our support team will investigate and help resolve the issue.

q3.question: Can I trust the travelers?
q3.answer: All travelers are KYC-verified. You can also check their ratings, reviews, and delivery history before choosing them.
